issues.title: Page links to a broken internal URL
issues.why: Visitors hit a dead end and link equity is wasted.
issues.fix: Update or remove the link.

issues.title: Missing <title>
issues.why: The title is the main ranking and click signal.
issues.fix: Add a unique title of 30–60 characters.

issues.title: Page returns an error status
issues.why: Visitors and Google get an error instead of content.
issues.fix: Fix the page, restore it, or redirect it to the closest live page.

issues.title: Missing <h1>
issues.why: No main heading tells search engines what the page is about.
issues.fix: Add one descriptive H1.

issues.title: Page is in the sitemap but set to noindex
issues.why: Conflicting signals waste crawl budget.
issues.fix: Remove it from the sitemap or remove the noindex.

issues.title: Page links to a redirected URL
issues.why: Each click takes an extra hop.
issues.fix: Link straight to the final URL.

issues.title: Images without alt attribute
issues.why: Alt text feeds image search and accessibility.
issues.fix: Add descriptive alt text (alt="" for pure decoration).

issues.title: Fewer than 200 words
issues.why: Thin pages rarely rank for competitive terms.
issues.fix: Add useful, unique content or consolidate the page.

issues.title: Missing meta description
issues.why: Google writes its own snippet, often a worse one.
issues.fix: Add a 70–160 character description.

issues.title: Duplicate title
issues.why: Several pages compete with an identical title.
issues.fix: Give each page a unique title.

issues.title: Duplicate meta description
issues.why: Identical snippets across pages.
issues.fix: Write a unique description per page.

issues.title: Page has no internal links pointing to it
issues.why: Crawlers and visitors cannot find it by clicking.
issues.fix: Link to it from relevant pages.

issues.title: Title shorter than 30 characters
issues.why: Short titles under-use the main ranking signal.
issues.fix: Expand with the page topic and brand.

issues.title: Near-identical page text
issues.why: Duplicate content splits ranking signals.
issues.fix: Merge, canonicalise or rewrite the pages.

issues.title: URL redirects
issues.why: Internal links should point at the final URL.
issues.fix: Update internal links to the destination.

issues.title: HTML document over 500 KB
issues.why: Heavy HTML slows parsing on phones.
issues.fix: Trim inline scripts and data from the document.

issues.title: Slow server response (over 800 ms)
issues.why: A slow first byte delays everything else.
issues.fix: Cache the page, tune the backend or use a CDN.

issues.title: Missing Open Graph tags
issues.why: Shared links will look plain on Facebook, LinkedIn and Slack.
issues.fix: Add og:title, og:description and og:image.

issues.title: Missing Twitter card
issues.why: Shared links on X will look plain.
issues.fix: Add twitter:card.

issues.title: No structured data
issues.why: No eligibility for rich results.
issues.fix: Add JSON-LD (Product, Article, FAQ, Organization…).

issues.title: Meta description shorter than 70 characters
issues.why: A short snippet misses a chance to sell the click.
issues.fix: Expand to 70–160 characters.

issues.title: Only one internal link points to this page
issues.why: Little internal authority flows to it.
issues.fix: Add contextual internal links.

issues.title: Same H1 on several pages
issues.why: Pages are not clearly differentiated.
issues.fix: Make each H1 specific to its page.
